# Songlines

> Songlines is the world's leading magazine and discovery platform for world music, offering reviews, awards recognition, and curated content across print and digital formats.

Songlines combines a respected print and digital magazine with an annual Music Awards program that celebrates the best in world music across Africa, Asia, the Americas, and beyond. The platform serves as a comprehensive resource for music discovery, featuring album reviews, artist interviews, and playlists across major streaming services including Spotify, Apple Music, and Deezer.

## Key Topics

- World Music
- Songlines Music Awards

## Subscriptions & Access

- [Subscribe to Songlines](https://www.songlines.co.uk/subscribe): Magazine subscription page offering print and digital access to Songlines
- [Sign up for the Songlines Newsletter](https://www.songlines.co.uk/newsletter): Free weekly e-newsletter signup for world and folk music discovery

## Magazine & Content

- [Songlines Magazine – Explore the Latest Issues](https://www.songlines.co.uk/magazine): Magazine hub with latest issues, interviews, and free cover CDs
- [Reviews Hub](https://www.songlines.co.uk/reviews-hub): Searchable album reviews database featuring world music artists

## Songlines Music Awards

- [Awards Hub](https://www.songlines.co.uk/awards): Main awards hub showcasing Songlines Music Awards program
- [Songlines Music Awards 2025](https://www.songlines.co.uk/awards/2025): 2025 Music Awards winners recognizing best new world music
- [Songlines Music Awards 2024](https://www.songlines.co.uk/awards/2024-best-of-2024): 2024 awards featuring Mdou Moctar and reader-voted winners
- [Songlines Music Awards 2023](https://www.songlines.co.uk/awards/2023): 2023 Music Awards nominees, winners and Apple Music playlist
- [Songlines Music Awards 2022](https://www.songlines.co.uk/awards/2022): 2022 awards ceremony featuring Youssou N'Dour and artists
- [Songlines Music Awards 2021](https://www.songlines.co.uk/awards/2021): Virtual 2021 awards event with BBC 6Music and world music winners
- [Songlines Music Awards 2020](https://www.songlines.co.uk/awards/2020): 2020 awards ceremony with live performances and playlist
- [Songlines Music Awards 2019](https://www.songlines.co.uk/awards/2019): 2019 awards ceremony held at EartH in London
- [Songlines Music Awards 2018](https://www.songlines.co.uk/awards/2018): 2018 awards at Electric Brixton with live performances
- [Songlines Music Awards 2017](https://www.songlines.co.uk/awards/2017): 2017 awards ceremony recognizing world music artists
